memory_candidates.content: When wiring a newly-authored named test/component into several consumer files by reference, a drift grep on the component's signature phrase (e.g. the default statement) can still miss consumers that paraphrase the full reason/criteria list inline rather than copying the exact phrase. Check consumer files for restated enumerated lists (count the items, not just the trigger phrase) in addition to grepping the exact wording -- a consumer that writes out all N reasons in its own words defeats the single-source-of-truth goal just as much as a verbatim copy, but evades a literal-string drift check.

This agent-system has two distinct, same-domain mechanisms that both produce task serialization from file_scope overlap: multi-task-creation-standard.md's Component 4a (creation-time, auto-adds a dependencies[] edge when proposed tasks' file_scope overlaps) and orchestrate-batch-admit.sh's dispatch-time 'file_scope_collision' admission gate (defers a candidate at /orchestrate dispatch time). They are easy to conflate when writing an illustrative example because both are triggered by the same overlapping file_scope and both result in serialization -- but they fire at different times (creation vs. dispatch) via different code paths. Name both explicitly when illustrating a file_scope-overlap scenario rather than attributing the effect to either one alone.
